title: Special Executive Programme In Managing People in Health and Social Care
description: The aim of this special executive programme is to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to effectively manage individuals and teams within the healthcare and social care sectors.
longDescription: The aim of the Managing People in Health and Social Care course is to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to effectively manage individuals and teams within the healthcare and social care sectors. By the end of the course, students will be able to apply key principles and practices of leadership, team building, communication, performance management, and conflict resolution to improve patient outcomes, enhance the quality of care, and create a positive and inclusive work environment for healthcare and social care professionals. The course also aims to provide students with an understanding of the legal and regulatory frameworks that govern healthcare and social care services, including issues related to diversity and equality, and how to apply these principles in their management practices.

modules.title: MANAGING PEOPLE IN HEALTH AND SOCIAL CARE
modules.summary: Managing People in Health and Social Care is a course that provides an overview of the principles and practices of managing individuals and teams within the healthcare and social care sectors. The course covers topics such as leadership, team building, communication, performance management, and conflict resolution. It also explores the legal and regulatory frameworks that govern healthcare and social care services, including issues related to diversity and equality. Throughout the course, students will learn how to apply these principles and practices to enhance the delivery of patient-centered care, improve patient outcomes, and create a positive and inclusive work environment for healthcare and social care professionals.
